responsibility: Provides the core machinery for translating Rust types, files, scopes, globals, and vtables into LLVM debuginfo metadata, including creation of `DIType` graphs for the full range of Rust layouts, source file metadata, field/member metadata, visibility and namespace attachment, and vtable-specific metadata needed by debuggers and LLVM optimizations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the top-level `metadata.rs`, which reads the `.rustc` crate metadata section from compiled artifacts, this file builds LLVM debuginfo metadata (`DIType`, file/scope, global, and vtable records) for debugger consumption during codegen. Its "metadata" is DWARF/LLVM debug metadata, not rustc crate metadata discovery or section naming.
